basis: Observed Pro response2m37s in existing compass ai conversation
requested_answer_correctness: Grade the requested value/name. Wrong auxiliary claims do not erase a correct requested label but invalidate the supporting explanation; never call the whole response correct.
rationale_validity: No material false rules, arithmetic, temporal claims or conclusion link. Explicit wrong-source attribution also fails. Mere conclusion repetition fails; concise core criteria plus filter result may pass.
citations: Accuracy and coverage distinguished. Partial cross-source citation is allowed only when the cited source supports the claim it is attached to and full coverage was not requested; explicit wrong attribution is not an omission.
training_change: Intersection explanations state all three criteria and the qualified set/count; general retention targets place cited evidence before final answer. This is before any training and does not change sealed inputs or keys.
